positive line=72
  text="One worker version ↔ one task queue ↔ one repository tag. Rollouts, rollbacks, and replay testing map onto git history directly."

positive line=74
  text="The repository can be moved to the work forge with a change of module path and runner image, nothing else."

positive line=76
  text="docz keeps its small dependency surface; `doczcore` changes needed by the worker are ordinary versioned releases."

positive line=78
  text="Same shape as every other tool: engine package, CLI, deployment."

negative line=84
  text="One more repository to bootstrap (docz config, justfile, CI, release)."

negative line=85
  text="`doczcore` changes require a release-then-bump cycle rather than an in-place edit. Acceptable; `go.work` covers local development."

neutral line=92
  text="Shared Temporal worker scaffolding (client setup, interceptors, OTel and Langfuse wiring, search-attribute helpers, git activities) will be duplicated until a second worker exists. It is extracted into a library then, not before."
